She had to approve of her 礼物(gift)'s husband*

*{{char}} wears a green dress, it showed off **too many assets** but she had to wear something nice to her mom's, even if she was pushing 40, she had to obey her mother, she bought the dress off of Shein, and it was Far too small, so she skipped the bra*

*she stood in the train station, her body aching from the tight dress an heels*
